raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Electricity tariffs remain below the cost of service, causing severe sector financial deficits that could reach 36 percent by end of 2025 and impair utility financial viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide World Bank technical assistance to support the Ministry of Energy and Energy Regulatory Commission on tariff reform strategy and utility financial sustainability.",
      "evidence": "financial deficit in the sector could reach 36 percent of system costs by the end of 2025"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Heavy reliance on aging, inefficient coal-fired combined heat and power plants (>40 years old) creates operational inflexibility that restricts variable renewable energy integration.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Reinforce transmission corridor capacity and implement battery energy storage systems alongside advanced grid planning to enhance dispatch flexibility.",
      "evidence": "Most of the CHP units are aging... inefficient and highly polluting. The CHP plants make the power system inflexible"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Lack of grid redundancy along the single-circuit Baganuur-Choir line restricts power evacuation from existing 160 MW renewables and causes severe supply outages.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct a new 220kV double-circuit transmission line from Baganuur to Choir to increase transmission capacity by 600 MW and introduce grid redundancy.",
      "evidence": "its output is constrained due to the limit of the transmission capacity of the Baganuur-Choir 220kV single-circuit line"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Severe winter weather in Mongolia restricts civil works to a short construction window, where failure to complete within one season causes multi-month project delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Advance procurement preparation prior to the construction season and utilize rated selection criteria prioritizing technical approaches optimized for short construction windows.",
      "evidence": "seasonal nature of civil works in Mongolia adds more risks... If it cannot be completed before winter, the Project will have more delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Heavy reliance on imported construction materials (75-80%) exposes the project to border disruptions, global supply chain bottlenecks, and severe cost inflation.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct market intelligence during procurement planning, allow advance procurement, and proactively monitor material sourcing routes.",
      "evidence": "75-80% of construction materials are sourced from outside the country... border closures could have a significant impact"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Overhead high-voltage transmission lines present significant collision and electrocution hazards to avifauna, particularly where corridors traverse or approach wetlands.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Realign line routing away from sensitive wetland habitats and install bird-friendly power transmission line solutions including flight diverters under a Bird Management Plan.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines in Mongolia often involve bird collision and other biodiversity issues"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Domestic contractors lack skilled technical human resources and local capacity to manufacture 220kV-compliant metal poles, conductors, and substation equipment.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Structure procurement using international Request for Bids to engage experienced international suppliers and EPC contractors while encouraging domestic joint ventures.",
      "evidence": "there is no local company who can produce metal poles and conductors meeting the standards for 220kV lines"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Administrative and technical capacity limits in the Ministry of Energy cause procurement bottlenecks and project implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated Project Management Office, recruit experienced technical staff, and hire an Owner's Engineer to support procurement and supervision.",
      "evidence": "Previous infrastructure projects in Mongolia have experienced implementation delays due to the administrative and technical capacity constraints of the implementing agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Frequent political turnover of key government officials and high-level interference in decision-making disrupt procurement execution and delay approvals.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish an interagency Project Steering Committee chaired by MOE and formalize clear approval workflows in the Project Operational Manual.",
      "evidence": "Frequent change of the decision-making officials for the Project. Interference of the high-level officials in procurement decision making"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Newly appointed PMO staff lack familiarity with World Bank financial management and procurement regulations, risking initial procedural non-compliance and reporting delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a comprehensive Financial Management Manual and POM before effectiveness, and conduct mandatory World Bank training for PMO financial and procurement staff.",
      "evidence": "PMO is not yet in place and no financial management staff has been appointed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Extreme climate hazards such as severe freezing, heavy snow, high wind loads, and floods cause structural damage or collapse of transmission towers and substations.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate resilient design standards into tower structures considering peak projected wind speeds, extreme temperature ratings, insulator icing, and flood/earthquake resilience.",
      "evidence": "Mongolia is prone to risks from climate hazards such as flooding, wildfires, and landslides, with exposure to drought and extreme cold"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Widespread availability of substandard construction materials (40% unqualified in local market) threatens line structural integrity and safety.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate non-price rated criteria in procurement for quality control strategies and mandate rigorous material testing and verification prior to installation.",
      "evidence": "40% of construction materials were found unqualified in the local market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Complex Treasury Single Account arrangements and local currency investment project accounts lead to funds flow bottlenecks and payment delays to contractors.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish segregated Designated Accounts and Treasury investment sub-accounts, with delegated signing authority for operational expenses defined in the FMM.",
      "evidence": "Delays and bottlenecks in the project funds flow arrangements that got complicated with the addition of an investment project account within the Treasury"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Civil construction works create temporary community safety risks and temporarily restrict local herders' access to pastures and water wells.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Resettlement Policy Framework and Stakeholder Engagement Plan, and establish a two-stage Grievance Redress Mechanism accessible to local herders.",
      "evidence": "temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders (for example, pasture, wells, etc.)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Civil works and transmission line footing excavations along the right-of-way could inadvertently damage undiscovered archaeological sites.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce mandatory Chance Find Procedures under ESS8 and conduct archaeological screening along the alignment prior to construction activities.",
      "evidence": "may damage the archeological sites near the OHTL, use of quarries for construction materials"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Evaluation Committee members lack experience in handling English-language bidding documents for international market approaches, leading to bid evaluation delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide evaluation scoring guidelines, translation assistance, and hands-on procurement support from World Bank specialists during international bid evaluations.",
      "evidence": "Evaluation Committee members normally do not have knowledge and experience in handling English documents, and it may cause delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Gender-based biases restrict female employment and advancement into mid- and senior-level technical and managerial positions at NPTG.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Conduct a workplace gender gap assessment, adopt gender-responsive HR policies, provide leadership training for female staff, and track workforce gender metrics.",
      "evidence": "gender-based biases may be an obstacle to women’s employment and especially to career progression at NPTG."
    }
  ]
}
